title: How is Mao Zedong connected to Shrek?
description:
A 1975 handshake in Beijing, an Oval Office meeting and a White House concert connect Mao Zedong to Shrek.

Mao Zedong → Henry Kissinger → Barack Obama → Mike Myers → Shrek

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Mao Zedong → Henry Kissinger: In 1975, Mao Zedong shook hands with Henry Kissinger in Beijing, as President Gerald Ford looked on.
   Photo by / Courtesy Gerald R. Ford Library, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kissinger,_Ford_and_Mao,_1975_A7912.jpg
2. Henry Kissinger → Barack Obama: In 2009, Kissinger came to the Oval Office to advise President Barack Obama on nuclear weapons.
   Photo by Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:P051909PS-0435_(3582763391).jpg
3. Barack Obama → Mike Myers: In 2012, Mike Myers performed for Obama at a White House concert honoring Burt Bacharach.
   Photo by The White House (video frame), Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:052112_Mike_Myers.webm
4. Mike Myers → Shrek: And since 2001, Mike Myers has been the voice of Shrek.
   Photo by DoD News, DreamWorks Pictures (via IMP Awards), CC BY 2.0 / Fair use (commentary): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mike_Myers_2017_(37220071326)_(cropped).jpg + http://www.impawards.com/2001/shrek_ver3.html

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#maozedong #shrek #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment: Who should I connect next? Two names, the weirder the better.
